title: GPIO Register Operations (Set, Clear, Toggle, Read)
description:
In embedded systems, hardware peripherals and GPIO pins are controlled by memory-mapped registers. You must manipulate individual bits without modifying any other bits in the register.

### Requirements:
1. `gpio_set_pin(uint16_t *reg, uint8_t pin)`: Sets bit `pin` in `*reg`.
2. `gpio_clear_pin(uint16_t *reg, uint8_t pin)`: Clears bit `pin` in `*reg`.
3. `gpio_toggle_pin(uint16_t *reg, uint8_t pin)`: Inverts bit `pin` in `*reg`.
4. `gpio_read_pin(uint16_t reg, uint8_t pin)`: Returns 1 if bit `pin` is set, 0 if cleared.
hint:
Common bitwise idioms:
- Set bit n: `*reg |= (1 << n);`
- Clear bit n: `*reg &= ~(1 << n);`
- Toggle bit n: `*reg ^= (1 << n);`
- Read bit n: `(reg >> n) & 1;`
